selection_semantics.rule: Stage1 may assign multiple opaque requirements to one reusable effect or place selected requirements in one disposition array; fixed collection order remains unchanged for execution.

reach_target.description: Move one named ALOHA gripper to a supplied world-frame target and hold it.
required_observation_affordances: left and right gripper pose observation

move_bimanual_targets.description: Move both named ALOHA grippers to supplied paired world-frame targets and hold them.
required_observation_affordances: left and right gripper pose observation

cycle_bimanual_grippers.description: Open and close both ALOHA grippers once through their coupled finger actuators.
required_observation_affordances: left and right finger joint observation

move_bimanual_offset_and_return.description: Apply supplied Cartesian offsets to both ALOHA grippers, hold, and return to their pre-invocation poses.
required_observation_affordances: left and right gripper pose observation
